description: Pay-per-call LLM, no API key. Sends messages to Fuse chat completions; agentpay settles the standard x402 v2 BSV 402 from this wallet and returns the completion plus receiptUrl and txid. Models: fuse-fast (500 sats) or fuse-smart (2500 sats). Wallet limits, scoped keys, and trial budgets apply. Pass dryRun to quote without spending.

amountCents.description: Override the USD cents charged (min 1 cent default)

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior approval_required response

dryRun.description: Quote + policy check only, no debit or settlement

key.description: Agent key (agp_…). Optional when the MCP connection sends Authorization: Bearer.

model.description: Fuse model (default fuse-fast). fuse-fast = 500 sats, fuse-smart = 2500 sats.

name: chat
